title: Unbounded C copy function — review required
description: strcpy/strcat/sprintf/gets copy without checking that the destination fits, so overlong input overflows into adjacent memory. This lexical rule cannot prove sizes are wrong — treat every hit as review-required, not as proven overflow.
remediation: Use bounded variants (strncpy/strncat/snprintf with the real destination size, fgets instead of gets) and verify lengths at every copy. Prefer C++ std::string or safe abstractions in new code.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any listed call matches, including copies the author already bounds-checked. gets() has no safe use and should always be removed.
